== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The Miners are a small, specialized order within the [[Consultants]], consisting of only forty-two students. They serve as the organization's archivists, tasked with the vital responsibility of maintaining and organizing the [[Consultants]]' extensive records. Because they manage sensitive personnel data for [[Gray Island]], members of this order are bound by strict oaths of secrecy. Within the broader [[Guild]] structure, they are characterized as highly disciplined individuals who follow instructions precisely and rarely voice personal opinions. While the term is also used to describe laborers performing dangerous tasks such as digging or harvesting aura in high-risk environments, the formal order functions as the keepers of truth and history for their superiors.}}
